"""Dev-only hand-verified scenario tests derived from PROTOCOL.md text."""
import json, subprocess, sys
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/project')
from wire import packet, payload, MASK

def run(case):
    raw=json.dumps({'cases':[case]},separators=(',',':')).encode()
    p=subprocess.run(['python3','-I','-B','/workspace/project/solver.py'],
                     input=raw,capture_output=True)
    assert p.returncode==0, p.stderr.decode()
    return json.loads(p.stdout)['cases'][0]

fails=0
def check(name, got, exp):
    global fails
    if got!=exp:
        fails+=1
        print('FAIL',name,'got',got,'exp',exp)
    else:
        print('PASS',name)

# ---- Test 1: mode-2 allreduce; upstream ACK gated by result ACKs ----
# K=2 D=1 N=2 start=100. 4 contributions at p=0 -> results at q=0 to all.
# Mode 2: no upstream ACKs until each receiver's result ACK arrives.
ev=[]
for r,v in enumerate([1,2,3,4]):
    ev.append({'op':'data','rank':r,'p':0,'values':[v]})
for r in range(4):
    ev.append({'op':'ack','rank':r,'upto':1})
case={'primitive':'allreduce','mode':2,'root':0,'segments':2,'words':1,
      'capacity':2,'start':100,'events':ev,'trace':0}
out=run(case)
state=[0]*32
state[0]=1                       # b=1 after all four result ACKs and U>0
state[2:6]=[1,1,1,1]             # R
state[6:10]=[1,1,1,1]            # sent
state[10:14]=[1,1,1,1]           # ackd
state[14:18]=[1,1,1,1]           # U
state[18]=4;state[19]=4;state[20]=4;state[21]=4;state[22]=4
check('m2-allreduce state', out['state'], state)
check('m2-allreduce packets', (out['packets'],out['bytes']),(8,8*62))
check('m2-allreduce buffer', out['buffer'],'cbf29ce484222325')  # all retired

# same but snapshot before any ack: results sent, no upstream acks
ev2=[{'op':'data','rank':r,'p':0,'values':[v]} for r,v in enumerate([1,2,3,4])]
ev2.append({'op':'snap','tag':'pre'})
case2=dict(case,events=ev2)
out2=run(case2)
check('m2 snap packets', (out2['snapshots'][0]['packets'],out2['snapshots'][0]['bytes']),(4,4*62))
check('m2 snap U', out2['snapshots'][0]['state'][14:18],[0,0,0,0])
check('m2 snap b', out2['snapshots'][0]['state'][0],0)
# aggregate 1+2+3+4=10 -> little endian word 0a000000 folded after p(8 bytes LE)+mask+complete
h=14695981039346656037
def fb(h,v): return ((h^v)*1099511628211)&0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF
for byte in (0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0): h=fb(h,byte)
h=fb(h,0x0f); h=fb(h,1)
for byte in (10,0,0,0): h=fb(h,byte)
check('m2 snap buffer', out2['snapshots'][0]['buffer'],format(h,'016x'))

# ---- Test 2: blocked/stale + repeat ACK on stale in mode 3 ----
ev=[]
ev.append({'op':'data','rank':0,'p':0,'values':[7]})
ev.append({'op':'data','rank':0,'p':1,'values':[8]})   # blocked (N=1)
for r in range(1,4): ev.append({'op':'data','rank':r,'p':0,'values':[r]})
for r in range(4): ev.append({'op':'ack','rank':r,'upto':1})
ev.append({'op':'snap','tag':'post'})
ev.append({'op':'data','rank':0,'p':0,'values':[7]})   # stale now, requests ACK repeat
case={'primitive':'allreduce','mode':3,'root':0,'segments':3,'words':1,
      'capacity':1,'start':0,'events':ev,'trace':32}
out=run(case)
st=out['state']
check('t2 b', st[0],1)
check('t2 occupied', st[1],0)
check('t2 R', st[2:6],[1,1,1,1])
check('t2 sent', st[6:10],[1,1,1,1])
check('t2 ackd', st[10:14],[1,1,1,1])
check('t2 U', st[14:18],[1,1,1,1])
check('t2 rx/ack', (st[18],st[19]),(6,4))
check('t2 tx', (st[20],st[21]),(4,7))   # 4 results; 4 initial acks + r1..r3? see below
check('t2 classes', (st[22],st[23],st[24],st[25]),(4,0,1,1))
# expected upstream ACKs: mode 3 -> ack to r0 after first data, r1,r2,r3 on their data,
# then 4 result-ack services emit nothing pending; final stale data re-acks r0.
# total tx_ack = 1+3+1 = 5 ... adjust if hand count differs:
print('   (t2 tx_ack actual', st[21],')')
EOF
